summary:
Turn 40 read the last protocol-relevant deferred surface — the master — and resolved the ballot-monotonicity unknown with two new sources, recording the relationship in the map.

What was established. The master owns the replica's leader flag. At registration it marks one replica as leader: the alias named by the config's Leader field, or, when no Leader is configured, the replica with the lowest ping RTT measured by the master's ping command; it reports IsLeader to that replica and calls Replica.BeTheLeader on it during master startup. When its ping loop later finds a leader dead, it promotes another replica through the same call. For this target that call lands in epaxos.Replica.BeTheLeader, which sets IsLeader = true and returns nil, so the master's leader/nextLeader fields stay at their defaults and the promoted replica keeps the designation. IsLeader then feeds makeBallot, which raises the ballot above maxRecvBallot while the flag is set, so a promoted replica can out-ballot anything it has seen when it recovers an instance.

Map update (accepted base version 7, one clarified object). Behavior B14-ballot-monotonicity's unknown about what sets IsLeader is replaced by that sourced relationship, and a branch records the two master call sites. The ballot arithmetic, the nack-driven prepare path and the protocol-level ownership statement (no global leader, term or log in the instantiated protocol) are unchanged; the master's flag is a deployment notion that feeds replica ballot behaviour, which is why it belongs to B14's description. The map_changes entry carries the sources and a preserves explanation.

Remaining, recorded rather than folded in. Whether the launched configuration sets a Leader alias at all (aws.conf was not read), which decides between the configured designation and the lowest-ping-RTT choice; whether IsLeader = true changes the confirmed recovery finding, where the reasoning says the masking should persist because the self entry's VBallot still equals the newly made ballot but no check has been run with the flag set (kept as a remaining question rather than extending the confirmed claim's scope); and the visible debts — the scope-issue bookkeeping on the superseded C1 artifact and the unread helper surfaces (replica/sender.go, replica/mset.go, hook/). No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
